title: Religious Education in the Author’s Account of Children’s Rights
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين — عماد بن أحمد بن عبدالعظيم (الألوكة). القرآن الكريم — التحريم: 6
text_original: قال تعالى: ﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارًا وقودها الناس والحجارة عليها ملائكة غلاظ شداد لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم ويفعلون ما يؤمرون﴾ [التحريم: 6].
text_simplified: The author presents teaching children the Quran, Sunnah and creed, guiding their conduct, and keeping them away from prohibited acts as parental responsibilities. He bases this account on the verse in Surah al-Tahrim about protecting oneself and one’s family from the Fire.

review_defects.why: تأديبهم means disciplining them, which is stronger than 'guiding their conduct'.
The Arabic does not name Surah al-Tahrim; the English adds this identification.
